slides.title: SIGNAL DESK
slides.summary: Community intelligence. Municipal action.

slides.title: A validated intake foundation; a commercial model to prove
Read the plan through three decision lenses
Conflicting source assumptions are disclosed, not blended
slides.summary: S1: supplied text. S2: pitch deck, 15 Oct 2026. S3: supplied growth and expansion plan.

slides.title: Fragmented signals create a handoff problem
Ward 115 provides depth, not proof of paid demand
slides.summary: S3 pp. 3–4; historical units must not be added together.

slides.title: Pilot periods and current intake must stay distinct
slides.summary: Do not reconcile different dates or definitions into one traction claim.

slides.title: Capture → link → act → verify → learn
Expand the orchestration layer, not municipal infrastructure
Sell evidence to fund free civic participation
slides.summary: No signed commercial agreements or validated sponsor prices supplied.

slides.title: A grounded market starts with identifiable budget owners
Keep market estimates separate from obtainable revenue
slides.summary: No external market verification commissioned; estimates are not presented as independently substantiated.

slides.title: Compete on traceable orchestration and local adoption
Win a bounded scope before scaling the footprint
First-year delivery follows four evidence gates
slides.summary: Ward 115 plus up to four additional wards; free users are not counted as paying seats.

slides.title: Three horizons; regional launches remain conditional
Hiring must follow revenue and funded delivery capacity
slides.summary: S1 reference FTEs: 5 / 6 / 7 / 9 / 10; blended $45k/year. Founder experience: S2, 10+ and 28+ years.

slides.title: Governed data is a prerequisite, not a monetisation shortcut
Principal risks have explicit owners and responses
Financial projections are planning cases, not actual results
Customer counts drive the paid-seat reference case
slides.summary: S1 model reproduced as an alternative; paid councillor assumptions conflict with S3 free-core strategy.

slides.title: Five-year revenue reaches $581k in the source case
slides.summary: US$000; source assumptions, not contracted sales. Data and advertising lack supplied price × volume drivers.

slides.title: Revenue scale and cost discipline must converge
slides.summary: Source-reference annual results in US$000; editable PowerPoint chart elements.

slides.title: Gross margins rise to 93%; delivery costs need validation
slides.summary: Support, security, data licensing fulfilment and payment processing may add costs not identified in S1.

slides.title: Personnel dominates the operating cost base
slides.summary: Hardware is reclassified as capital expenditure only in the illustrative integrated statements below.

slides.title: Integrated profit & loss normalises hardware treatment
slides.summary: No cash tax assumed due to accumulated losses; no deferred tax asset recognised. Tax eligibility and loss use require local advice.

slides.title: Cash flow exposes the funding requirement
slides.summary: Equity plugged annually to prevent negative year-end cash, not committed capital. Excludes minimum cash reserve and intra-year timing.

slides.title: Illustrative balance sheet reconciles to the cash model
slides.summary: No debt or payables assumed. Assets = contributed equity + retained earnings; opening balance assumed zero, not historical accounts.

slides.title: A $100k raise does not fund the supplied staffing plan
Twelve-month bridge makes the early cash gap visible
slides.summary: S1 Year-1 totals divided evenly by 12; $100k opening cash. Excludes receivables timing; illustrative bridge, not a seasonal acquisition forecast.

slides.title: Free-core strategy requires replacement payer revenue
slides.summary: Retains all other unvalidated source assumptions. No sponsor prices invented. Year-5 gap $145k = 15 additional $10k contracts before delivery costs.

slides.title: Exit subscription run-rate is not total annual revenue
Small revenue misses remove Year-5 break-even
slides.summary: Illustrative proportional revenue changes; COGS fixed conservatively. No probability weights, receivables or additional investment included.

slides.title: The source raise is a gated first tranche
Approve scale only when evidence and cash align
Management decisions required before external circulation
slides.summary: Consulting-inspired presentation; not affiliated with, prepared by, or endorsed by KPMG or McKinsey.

slides.title: Every claim has a source or an assumption label
SIGNAL DESK
slides.summary: Confirm the payer model. Fund the next evidence gate.
